regime_read: Convergence is concentrated in semiconductors, AI/software demand, and a few idiosyncratic situations rather than a broad market signal. With no completed track-record observations, conviction remains modest; sentiment-heavy clusters deserve less weight than combinations involving disclosed buying, contracts, patents, or operating demand.
regime_read_zh: 当前信号主要集中在半导体、AI/软件需求及少数特殊情形，并非广泛的市场信号。由于尚无已完成评分的历史判断，整体置信度保持克制；相比披露买入、合同、专利或经营需求，偏情绪驱动的聚类应给予更低权重。

theses.thesis: MU has the cleanest multi-source alignment: four members contributed positive congressional net activity, insider buying pressure is strongly positive, grant activity is accelerating, and the patent cluster shows continuing technical investment [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]. Bullish Stocktwits activity adds confirmation but is the least independent input [stocktwits_bull]. The stock is non-extended and has lagged SPY over 60 days, so the signal is not being chased.
theses.thesis_zh: MU呈现最清晰的多源共振：四名国会议员形成正向净交易，内部人士买入压力显著为正，政府拨款活动加速，同时专利聚类显示技术投入仍在持续 [congress_cluster] [insider_mspr] [gov_grant_accel] [patent_cluster]。Stocktwits的看多情绪提供补充确认，但其独立性最低 [stocktwits_bull]。该股未处于涨幅过度状态，过去60日相对SPY落后，因此并非追涨。
second_order: AMAT — semiconductor-capex beneficiary supported separately by congressional activity and its patent cluster
Memory-equipment and advanced-packaging suppliers — beneficiaries if MU's patent and grant activity translates into capacity investment
theses.dissent: The 60-day relative underperformance may reflect deteriorating memory fundamentals that alternative activity has not yet captured.

falsifier.text: Insider buying pressure turns nonpositive while grant acceleration reverses and congressional net activity ceases.

theses.clamped: lean 'overweight' → 'underweight' (deterministic witness); conviction 'medium' → 'low' (deterministic ceiling); action 'ACCUMULATE' → 'AVOID' (deterministic ceiling)

theses.thesis: MSFT's signal spans measured end-user demand, developer activity, model usage, and invention output rather than relying on one financial-flow channel [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]. The Sam Altman partnership relationship provides an AI ecosystem link [actor:Sam Altman], while the disclosed Bill Ackman affiliation is supportive but qualitative [actor:Bill Ackman]. Relative strength is positive but remains below the extended threshold.
theses.thesis_zh: MSFT的信号横跨可测量的终端需求、开发者活动、模型使用量和创新产出，并非依赖单一资金流渠道 [app_demand] [github_momentum] [hf_model_momentum] [patent_cluster]。与Sam Altman的合作关系提供AI生态联系 [actor:Sam Altman]，Bill Ackman的披露关联亦偏正面，但属于定性信息 [actor:Bill Ackman]。相对强势为正，但仍低于涨幅过度阈值。
second_order: AMD — potential compute beneficiary if model and developer activity translates into broader AI infrastructure demand
MU — potential memory beneficiary from sustained cloud and model-workload growth
AI data-center infrastructure — downstream capacity theme implied by rising model usage
theses.dissent: App reviews, GitHub stars, and model downloads can measure engagement without proving incremental revenue or attractive returns on AI spending.

falsifier.text: Model downloads and GitHub momentum roll over together while app-demand measures weaken.

theses.thesis: LUV combines an activist-linked special-situation setup with strong app-demand evidence and multiple recent material filings [activist_13d] [app_demand] [material_8k]. Paul Singer's disclosed affiliation supplies the identifiable change agent [actor:Paul Singer]. The stock is non-extended, but the operating implication of the filings is unspecified, keeping conviction low.
theses.thesis_zh: LUV同时具备激进投资者推动的特殊情形、较强的应用端需求证据以及近期多份重大事项文件 [activist_13d] [app_demand] [material_8k]。Paul Singer的披露关联提供了明确的变革推动者 [actor:Paul Singer]。该股未处于涨幅过度状态，但文件对经营面的具体含义并未给出，因此置信度较低。
second_order: Airline ancillary-service providers — could benefit if app engagement reflects stronger booking activity
Domestic travel platforms — secondary beneficiary if LUV demand is part of broader travel resilience
theses.dissent: High app ratings and activist involvement do not establish improving airline margins, and the material filings could reflect disruption rather than progress.

falsifier.text: App-demand measures weaken and subsequent material filings show no operational or governance progress.

theses.thesis: PLTR has broad apparent convergence across government contracts, analyst revisions, retail attention, and bullish social sentiment [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]. However, several channels are correlated expressions of price enthusiasm, government-contract acceleration is only moderate, and the Trump-linked signal is explicitly on the sell side [trump]. At +28.7 percentage points versus SPY over 60 days, it is not formally extended but is close enough to make WATCH more disciplined than adding exposure.
theses.thesis_zh: PLTR表面上在政府合同、分析师上调、散户关注和社交平台看多情绪之间形成广泛共振 [gov_contract] [analyst_upgrade_cluster] [retail_buzz] [stocktwits_bull]。但其中多个渠道可能只是价格热度的相关表达，政府合同加速度仅属温和，而且特朗普关联信号明确为卖出方向 [trump]。该股过去60日相对SPY领先28.7个百分点，虽未正式达到涨幅过度标准，但已足够接近，因此观察比追加敞口更审慎。
second_order: MSFT — enterprise-cloud and AI-platform read-through if government software adoption broadens
Government AI and data-integration vendors — potential beneficiaries of sustained federal procurement
theses.dissent: The cluster may mostly represent crowded enthusiasm, while the disclosed Trump-linked sell signal directly conflicts with the bullish channels.

falsifier.text: Government-contract activity decelerates while analyst and social sentiment turn neutral or negative.

theses.thesis: MRK's clinical pipeline activity, label-expansion channel, and special-situation signal align with a Trump-linked buy indication [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation] [trump]. The evidence is potentially fundamental, but four clinical halts materially offset the eleven Phase 3 starts. With relative strength already at +28.0 percentage points versus SPY, WATCH is preferable to pursuing the move.
theses.thesis_zh: MRK的临床管线活动、适应症标签扩展渠道和特殊情形信号，与特朗普关联的买入指示方向一致 [clinical_phase3_start] [fda_label_expansion] [special_situation] [trump]。这些证据可能具有基本面意义，但四项临床暂停明显抵消了十一项三期试验启动。鉴于其过去60日相对SPY已领先28.0个百分点，观察优于追涨。
second_order: Oncology diagnostics and care-planning services — possible beneficiaries if pipeline activity leads to broader cancer-treatment utilization
Clinical-research providers — potential beneficiary of numerous Phase 3 starts, tempered by the recorded halts
theses.dissent: The four clinical halts may signal pipeline quality or execution problems, and the political buy indicator lacks an identified actor in the pack.

falsifier.text: Clinical halts increase or key Phase 3 programs stop progressing without corresponding label-expansion progress.
